name: Spectrality of the adic spectrum
about: for every Huber ring, `Spa(A,A⁺)` is a spectral space (Wedhorn's Theorem 7.35).

name: Wedhorn's Proposition 8.2(2)
about: pullback along `A → A⟨T/s⟩` is [a homeomorphism from `Spa(A⟨T/s⟩, A_U⁺)` onto `R(T/s)`](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AdicSpace/Spa/Localization/CompletedHomeomorph.html#TauCeti.ValuationSpectrum.spaCompletedLocalizationHomeomorph) under which rational subsets correspond.

name: Local stalks
about: every stalk of the structure presheaf is a local ring whose maximal ideal is the support of the point valuation, which therefore factors through the residue field (for a pair of definition whose ring lies in `A⁺`).

name: Faithful flatness along a rational cover
about: for a finite rational cover of `Spa(A,A⁺)` over a complete Hausdorff strongly noetherian Tate ring, the map from `A` into the product of the coordinate rings is faithfully flat, hence injective: Wedhorn's Corollary 8.32.

name: Lemma 8.33 for the structure presheaf
about: over the same rings, sections over `{|f| ≤ 1}` and `{|f| ≥ 1}` that agree on the overlap come from a global section, uniquely. Degree zero only; surjectivity onto the overlap is proved for the coordinate rings.

name: The structure presheaf
about: built as a limit over admissible presentations and identified with Wedhorn's limit over rational subsets, it is [`A⟨T/s⟩` on a rational open](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AdicSpace/Spa/StructurePresheaf/Rational.html#TauCeti.ValuationSpectrum.presentationLimitRationalIso) and [`A` on the whole spectrum](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AdicSpace/Spa/StructurePresheaf/GlobalSections.html#TauCeti.ValuationSpectrum.presentationLimitTopIso) of a complete Hausdorff pair.

name: The plus presheaf `𝒪_X⁺`
about: the sections whose germs are sub-unit at every point, equal to [`A_U⁺` on a rational open](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AdicSpace/Spa/StructurePresheaf/Plus.html#TauCeti.ValuationSpectrum.map_completedPlusSubring_eq_presentationLimitPlusSubring) (Wedhorn's Proposition 8.16). With the local stalks, it completes §3.3.

name: Restriction to a rational subset
about: Wedhorn's Remark 8.4: over rational opens inside `R(T/s)`, the structure presheaf of `Spa(A,A⁺)` is naturally that of `Spa(A⟨T/s⟩, A_U⁺)`. It lets Lemma 8.33 be applied on rational subsets, as Lemma 8.34's induction needs.

name: The Riemann–Roch theorem
about: for `W` the divisor of a nonzero Weil differential, `ℓ(D) − ℓ(W − D) = deg D + 1 − g` for every divisor `D`, over any exact constant field.

name: The Hurwitz genus formula
about: `[k' : k] · (2g' − 2) = [F' : F] · (2g − 2) + [k' : k] · deg Diff(F'/F)` for `F'/F` finite separable with exact constants and `k'/k` finite separable.

name: The divisor of `dx`
about: for a separating element `x` of a field with exact constants, the Weil differential `dx` has divisor `−2 (x)_∞ + Diff(F/k(x))`, which is therefore canonical.

name: The Weierstrass equation of a genus-one field
about: at each rational place `P` of a genus-one field with exact constants, some `x` and `y` with pole divisors `2P` and `3P` satisfy a Weierstrass equation over `k` and generate the field, in the form `y² = x³ + a₂x² + a₄x + a₆` away from characteristic two.

name: Rigidity of automorphisms
about: over an exact constant field, an automorphism of `F/k` fixing `2g + 3` distinct rational places is the identity.

name: The analytic Euler product
about: on the half-plane of absolute convergence the local Euler factors have an unrestricted product over the height-one primes, equal to the `LSeries` of the norm coefficients.

name: Nonvanishing of the Dedekind zeta function to the right of one
about: `ζ_K s ≠ 0` for `Re s > 1`, since each local ratio lies strictly inside the unit disc.

name: The logarithmic derivative as a von Mangoldt series
about: for a completely multiplicative weight, `logDeriv L(s) = -∑' A, χ(A) Λ(A) N(A)⁻ˢ` right of the abscissa of absolute convergence, prime powers included.

name: The arithmetic Perron formula
about: for a series absolutely convergent on the line, the truncated Perron integral is the series of truncated kernels at the ratios `x / n`, with an off-norm error bound and the half-weight limit at integer endpoints.

name: Landau's theorem
about: a Dirichlet series with nonnegative coefficients whose abscissa of absolute convergence is the real number `σ` admits no analytic continuation across `σ`, now with its meromorphic-order corollary.

name: Landau's theorem
about: a Dirichlet series with nonnegative coefficients whose abscissa of absolute convergence is the real number `σ` admits no analytic continuation across `σ`, now with its meromorphic-order corollary.

name: Euler-product data
about: the package the export contract names: prime-power local series plus the coprime-multiplicativity proof, closed under product, conjugation, and restriction away from a finite prime set. Everything analytic above is stated for it, not for a bare ideal arithmetic function.

name: Prime-power ideals as a prime and an exponent
about: the bijection `(𝔭, k) ↦ 𝔭 ^ (k + 1)`, turning a sum supported on prime powers into a sum over primes and exponents and carrying the Taylor expansion of the local logarithms.

name: The von Mangoldt coefficient system of a prime set
about: the nonnegative coefficients whose inclusive partial sum is Chebyshev's ψ, in the `ℕ → ℝ` form a Tauberian theorem consumes.

name: Covers are determined by their triples
about: a connected degree-`n` cover of `ℂ ∖ {0, 1}` is determined up to isomorphism by the isomorphism class of its monodromy triple, and likewise with a numbered fibre or a marked point; surjectivity is open.

name: Dessins and triples classify each other
about: isomorphism classes of bipartite ribbon graphs with `n` edges correspond to isomorphism classes of degree-`n` permutation triples, with automorphism groups matching.

name: Dessins and triples classify each other

name: The Frobenius product-one formula
about: in a finite group `G`, the number of `(x, y, z) ∈ C₀ × C₁ × C∞` with `z y x = 1` is `(|C₀| |C₁| |C∞| / |G|) Σ_χ χ(C₀) χ(C₁) χ(C∞) / χ(1)`, with the roadmap's `S₃` checks.

name: Non-spherical triangle groups are infinite
about: `Δ(a, b, c)` is infinite whenever `1/a + 1/b + 1/c ≤ 1`: the commutator of the generators has infinite order, acting as a translation of `ℂ` or as a hyperbolic element of `PSL(2, ℝ)`.

name: The combinatorial Euler bound
about: a connected triple satisfies `χ = c(σ0) + c(σ1) + c(σinf) − n ≤ 2`, where `c` counts cycles, proved by induction along transpositions rather than through a surface.

name: The classification statement
about: every finite simple group is isomorphic to `CFSGIndex.Group i` for some index `i` on the list, stated and not proved; its universe-zero case implies every universe.

name: The Lie-type candidate groups
about: for every valid index, the derived subgroup of the Steinberg fixed points modulo its centre, the Steinberg map being `γ ∘ Frob_q` on the thirteen ordinary and graph-twisted constructors and an odd power of a half-Frobenius on the four Suzuki–Ree ones.

name: The characteristic-two F₄ special isogeny
about: an endomorphism of the short-root F₄ carrier over 𝔽₂ that exchanges long and short simple root subgroups, with exponent one on long roots and two on short ones, and squares to Frobenius; it is the Tits Steinberg map, and its odd powers are the Ree F₄ ones.

name: The sporadic presentation table
about: each of the twenty-six names carries a cited finite presentation with checked generator and relator counts; the Monster, Baby Monster and Fi₂₃ rows are proved to present their diagram's Coxeter group cut down by the relators their sources adjoin, and the Fi₂₄' row the commutator subgroup of its source's group.

name: Carrier agreement for the classical families
about: the type-A carrier is isomorphic to the points of `SL_{r+1}` over ℤ, matching the numbered simple root subgroups and intertwining the Steinberg maps of `A_r(q)` and `²A_r(q)`; the type-C, Suzuki and rank-two spin carriers do the same against `Sp`.

name: The ambient group of a valid Lie-type index
about: one definition for all seventeen constructors, the algebraic-closure points of the family's explicit carrier with its Bourbaki-numbered simple root subgroups and Frobenius maps, on which the uniform Steinberg map and candidate are built.

name: The odd-power Steinberg equations
about: if `τ` squares to `φ`, then `τ ^ (2m+1)` squares to `φ ^ (2m+1)` and moves the numbered root subgroups by the length permutation with exponent `p ^ m · e_i`, so each Suzuki–Ree branch supplies only its own `τ`.

name: Auditable presentations
about: relator expressions compile to signed words proved to denote them, and index-two Reidemeister–Schreier rewriting identifies the rewrite of a presentation by involutions with the commutator subgroup of the group it presents.

name: The auxiliary-prime theorem
about: above any bound it produces a prime congruent to `1` modulo a prescribed nonzero level, unramified in both number fields, with the corresponding cyclotomic polynomial irreducible over the base.

name: Artin-symbol restriction to a normal subextension
about: shrinking the top field carries the Artin class to the lower Artin class with no power or inverse.

name: The Artin-symbol base-change power law
about: raising the base field raises the original Artin class to the intermediate residue degree.

name: The tagged fixed-field cyclotomic theorem
about: when the order of a tag's first component divides that of its second, the compositum is cyclotomic over the fixed field of the generated cyclic subgroup.

name: Higher-prime-power removal for Frobenius `ψ`
about: the contribution beyond exponent one is `o(x)`, giving the first discard estimate needed to pass from `ψ_C` to `ϑ_C`.

name: The degree formula for the second cohomology of a class formation
about: ClassFormation.natCard_H2 gives the order of this cyclic group as the layer degree, with the fundamental class as generator.

name: The scaling laws for the fundamental class
about: fundamentalClass_restrict, fundamentalClass_cor, and fundamentalClass_infl establish its restriction and the relative-degree factors under corestriction and inflation.

name: Two-periodicity of cyclic Tate cohomology
about: Rep.FiniteCyclicGroup.periodicIso identifies degrees congruent modulo two.

name: Sylow reduction of cohomological vanishing
about: groupCohomology.isZero_of_isZero_sylow reduces vanishing to one Sylow subgroup for each prime.

name: Class formations
about: ClassFormation takes the invariant as data and derives the fundamental class; its separate subgroup-layer theorems supply the three hypotheses needed for Tate's theorem.

name: Finite normal layers
about: NormalLayer supplies norm quotients and cohomological maps, giving the eventual Artin map its source and its compatibility squares.

name: Class fields
about: classField fixes the field attached to an open normal subgroup, a common target for local and global existence.

name: The grid determinant formula and the Euler characteristic
about: the alternating Alexander state sum of a grid diagram is a sign times a monomial times the determinant of its weight matrix, and on an odd-component diagram that expression is the graded Euler characteristic of the bigraded chain module. That is milestone G.4 on the chain side: the determinant is not yet matched to the Alexander polynomial, and with `∂² = 0` open it is not an Euler characteristic of homology.

name: Links as grids modulo moves
about: GridLink is grid diagrams of every size modulo commutation and (de)stabilization, with two diagrams presenting the same link exactly when moves connect them: nothing waits on Cromwell's theorem.

name: The `U`-tower in every negative-definite plumbing
about: a minimal-weight lattice point is a cycle no nonzero multiple of which is a boundary, so the homology is nonzero; [`E₈`'s too](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/LowDimTopology/Plumbing/E8.html#TauCeti.e8Plumbing_not_isZero_latticeHomology) in every spin^c structure, though its rank is unknown.

name: Both blow-ups split the intersection form
about: blowing up at a vertex or along an edge adds an orthogonal `⟨-1⟩`, preserves and reflects negative-definiteness, and fixes the infimum of the characteristic weight: the Neumann moves in usable form, but nothing yet about homology.

name: The Koszul braiding on cochain complexes
about: `CochainComplex (ModuleCat R) ℤ` is a symmetric monoidal category with braiding `x ⊗ y ↦ (-1)^{|x||y|} y ⊗ x` on the summands of Mathlib's totalized tensor product, both hexagons proved at complex level.

name: The linear Hom complex enrichment
about: cochain complexes in an `R`-linear preadditive category are enriched in cochain complexes of `R`-modules, with closed degree-zero composition obtained from Keller composition through the Koszul braiding, and with underlying additive complex Mathlib's `HomComplex`.

name: The graded coderivation/Taylor correspondence
about: a `q`-twisted, Koszul-signed coderivation of the reduced tensor coalgebra is exactly its family of Taylor components, with inverse the signed Taylor expansion.

name: The suspended and unsuspended Stasheff identities agree
about: the suspended arity-`n` sum with no structural coefficient vanishes exactly when the unsuspended sum with `(-1)^{r+st}` does, and the arity 1–4 equations are evaluated verbatim.

name: Normalization of contractions
about: every contraction `(i, p, h)` of cochain complexes can be replaced, keeping `i` and `p`, by one satisfying `h i = 0`, `p h = 0`, `h h = 0`; a contraction is a homotopy equivalence and its two maps are quasi-isomorphisms.

name: Frieze–Kannan weak regularity
about: every graphon is within ε in cut norm of a block-averaged step graphon on a measurable partition with at most 4^(⌈1/ε²⌉+1) parts, the baseline exponent.

name: The counting lemma
about: |t(F,U) − t(F,W)| ≤ e(F)·‖U − W‖□ on one carrier, with a coupling form across carriers.

name: Forward separation
about: graphons on arbitrary probability carriers at coupling cut distance zero have the same homomorphism density for every graph on `Fin n`.

name: Coupling and map cut distance agree
about: over standard Borel carriers with atoms allowed, the coupling-primary `cutDist` equals the infimum over measure-preserving maps out of the unit interval, using Janson's Theorem A.9.

name: Goodman's inequality
about: triangle density is at least 2·t(K₂,W)² − t(K₂,W) for every graphon, with Mantel's bound as the triangle-free corollary.

name: Goodman's inequality

name: The coupling-primary cut distance
about: `IsCoupling` and the overlaid difference make `cutDist` well defined between graphons on any two probability spaces, with symmetry, the diagonal bound by the same-carrier cut norm, and pullback invariance of the cut norm behind it.

name: The AE view
about: a graphon's class in `AEEqFun` on the product carrier, through which `homDensity`, the cut norm and the cut distance all factor, with a strict representative recovered from any a.e. symmetric `[0,1]`-valued class; this lets Layer 4 argue in the a.e. world.

name: Coupling gluing
about: finite PMF gluing with explicit zero-mass middle atoms, and gluing of two plans over a countable middle space with no hypothesis on the outer spaces; the ingredients the triangle inequality is meant to be built from.

name: The Mordell–Weil theorem
about: the points of an elliptic curve over a number field form a finitely generated group, via a general version over Dedekind fraction fields.

name: The Mordell–Weil theorem

name: Global minimal models
about: over any Dedekind domain the global-minimality class is trivial exactly when the curve has a globally minimal equation (Silverman VIII.8.2), and every curve over `ℚ` has a unique reduced minimal equation.

name: The point count as a degree
about: over `𝔽_q`, deg(1 − π_q) = #E(𝔽_q), the identity that makes `q + 1 − #E(𝔽_q)` a trace.

name: [The de Finetti correspondence](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/Probability/DeFinetti/Correspondence.html#TauCeti.Probability.deFinettiEquiv)
about: mixing laws correspond bijectively and affinely to exchangeable path laws; product laws are exactly the zero-one, permutation-ergodic, and extreme exchangeable laws.

name: Isometry invariance of Riemannian volume
about: a differentiable homeomorphism whose tangent maps preserve the metric carries one Riemannian volume onto the other, with no orientation hypothesis, so the total volume of a compact Riemannian manifold is an isometry invariant.

name: Continuity of O(n+1) → Diff(Sⁿ)
about: the reference inclusion is continuous for the weak Whitney topology, and the smooth-families map makes any jointly smooth family of diffeomorphisms a continuous map into the space of diffeomorphisms.

name: Smooth concordance is an equivalence relation
about: concordance of smooth embeddings, stored in collared form so that concordances stack, is an equivalence relation for a finite-dimensional ambient model; knot concordance is the case of circle embeddings.

name: The Burau-Alexander polynomial is a Markov invariant
about: it changes only by a unit under either Markov move, which shows that the trefoil braid `σ₀³` is not Markov equivalent to the trivial braid.

name: The Tristram-Levine signature of a Seifert matrix
about: unchanged by congruence and by row and column enlargement, the moves that generate S-equivalence; at `ω = -1` it is the classical signature, `-2` for the trefoil and `0` for the figure eight.

about: generated by compact chart-derivative tests and inherited by the diffeomorphisms of a compact manifold, it is the space layer 3's homotopy-type statements live in.

about: the curvature of a smooth connection as a smooth tensor field, satisfying the first Bianchi identity for torsion-free connections and contracting to Ricci and scalar curvature.

name: Artin–Whaples weak approximation at mixed places
about: for finite sets of finite and infinite places, the diagonal image of a number field is dense in the product of the corresponding completions; this is the load-bearing export to Global Quadratic Forms, in exactly the mixed form that roadmap requires.

name: Normalized absolute value on an infinite completion
about: the monoid-with-zero homomorphism `x ↦ ‖x‖ ^ w.mult` on `w.Completion`, giving `|x|` at a real place and `|z|²` at a complex place, continuous and vanishing only at zero; it supplies the archimedean half of the local absolute values that the product formula and the idele norm will need.

name: Agreement with the global normalized value on `K`
about: on the dense copy of `K` the completion value is the normalized infinite-place value, which is what lets statements about `K` transfer to the completion.

name: Quaternary descent
about: a regular quaternary form whose plain discriminant is the class of a nonsquare `d` is isotropic over `F` exactly when it is isotropic over `F(√d)` (O'Meara 58:7), over any field in which `2` is invertible.

name: The quaternary case of Hasse–Minkowski
about: a regular quaternary form over a number field that is isotropic at every finite and real place is isotropic, provided the ternary case holds over every number field.

name: The Hasse–Minkowski induction step in rank at least five
about: a locally isotropic regular form of rank `n ≥ 5` is isotropic once the theorem holds in rank `n − 1`, with the scalar defined from an approximated vector as the roadmap pins.

name: Almost-all isotropy in rank at least three
about: such a form is isotropic at all but finitely many finite places; the bound is sharp, since `⟨1, 1⟩` over `ℚ` is anisotropic at infinitely many finite places.

name: Almost-all isotropy in rank at least three
about: such a form is isotropic at all but finitely many finite places; the bound is sharp, since `⟨1, 1⟩` over `ℚ` is anisotropic at infinitely many finite places.

name: Sylvester's law of inertia at a real place
about: regular forms become isometric at a real place exactly when their signatures agree, and every signature `(p, q)` is realized by `p⟨1⟩ ⊥ q⟨−1⟩`.

name: Canonical localizations
about: localizations at finite, real and complex places are genuine base changes along the completion maps, compatible with isometries, orthogonal sums, discriminants and towers of completions.

name: The local predicates
about: local isotropy, representation, scalar representation and equivalence range over finite and real places, and each is proved to imply its complex clause.

name: Vector weak approximation
about: one global vector lands in prescribed neighbourhoods at finitely many finite and real places, as the rank-five step requires.

name: Resolution theorem
about: for a property `P` of `E`-projectives containing zero and closed under biproducts, the inclusion of `P` into the objects of finite `P`-dimension induces an isomorphism on exact K₀, with inverse the alternating class of any finite resolution.

name: Euler–Poincaré theorem
about: in abelian K₀ the alternating class of the terms of a bounded cochain complex equals that of its cohomology, for any short-exact-additive invariant.

name: Horseshoe lemma
about: in any exact category, resolutions of a conflation's outer terms, the right one projective, combine to resolve its middle term; with Schanuel's lemma this lifts finite projective resolutions along conflations.

name: Ext-Euler pairing
about: for extension-closed properties whose pairs are Euler-admissible, `χ(X,Y) = ∑ (-1)ⁿ dim Extⁿ(X,Y)` descends to the unique biadditive pairing on the two exact K₀ groups.

name: Laurent normalisation of the shift
about: on the graded K₀ of a graded exact category, `qⁿ · [M] = [M{n}]`.

name: The Hodge decomposition
about: the components H^{p,n−p} = F^p ∩ conj F^{n−p} of a bounded n-opposed filtration form an internal direct sum, and conversely (Deligne's equivalence, `decompositionEquiv`).

name: Semisimplicity of polarizable rational Hodge structures
about: every rational Hodge substructure of a polarizable pure Hodge structure has a complement over ℚ and after complexification, orthogonal for some polarizing form; proved via the Weil operator and the positive-definite Hodge form.

name: Deligne's theorem on the bigrading
about: the pieces I^{p,q}, defined by Deligne's closed formula in F, conj F and W, form an internal direct sum of the complex space, recovering W_k as ⨆_{p+q≤k} I^{p,q} and F^p as ⨆_{p'≥p} I^{p',q'}.

name: Strictness of morphisms of mixed Hodge structures
about: a morphism is strict for the Hodge filtration, range f ⊓ F'^p = f(F^p), and likewise for the rational and the complexified weight filtrations.

name: The Hodge numbers partition the dimension
about: ∑ h^{p,n−p} = dim_ℂ V_ℂ, equal to the lattice rank, with Hodge symmetry h^{p,q} = h^{q,p}.

name: do Carmo's distance is Mathlib's distance
about: the infimum of lengths over piecewise-`C¹` paths equals `Manifold.riemannianEDist`, via a corner-smoothing theorem giving every piecewise-`C¹` path a `C¹` path of the same endpoints and length.

name: Existence and uniqueness of the Levi-Civita connection
about: the connection built from the Koszul formula is torsion-free and metric-compatible, and any two such connections agree (CovariantDerivative.isLeviCivita_leviCivita, CovariantDerivative.IsLeviCivita.unique).

name: Existence and uniqueness of the Levi-Civita connection
about: the connection built from the Koszul formula is torsion-free and metric-compatible, and any two such connections agree (CovariantDerivative.isLeviCivita_leviCivita, CovariantDerivative.IsLeviCivita.unique).

name: Smoothness of the Levi-Civita connection
about: on a `C^∞` manifold with a `C^∞` metric the connection is `C^∞`, and its Christoffel symbols are `C^∞` on every tangent-trivialization base set (CovariantDerivative.instContMDiffCovariantDerivativeLeviCivita, CovariantDerivative.contMDiffOn_christoffelSymbol_leviCivita).

name: Smoothness of the Levi-Civita connection
about: on a `C^∞` manifold with a `C^∞` metric the connection is `C^∞`, and its Christoffel symbols are `C^∞` on every tangent-trivialization base set (CovariantDerivative.instContMDiffCovariantDerivativeLeviCivita, CovariantDerivative.contMDiffOn_christoffelSymbol_leviCivita).

name: Geodesics have constant speed
about: on an open preconnected parameter set a geodesic has the same speed at every two parameters, the lemma that makes a geodesic Cauchy at a finite endpoint.

name: The finite-endpoint extension criterion
about: an integral curve of a `C¹` vector field on `Ioo a b` that accumulates at a point of the manifold as `t → b⁻` extends past `b`, with the left-endpoint analogue; hence the maximal integral curve has no cluster point at a finite endpoint.

name: The Weil–Cartier equivalence
about: on a Noetherian integral curve whose codimension-one local rings are discrete valuation rings, Weil divisors and Cartier divisors are additively equivalent.

name: Locally principal divisors give line bundles
about: the sheaf `𝒪_X(D)` of a locally principal Weil divisor on such a curve is locally free of rank one.

name: `Pic⁰` as a quotient
about: degree-zero divisors modulo principal divisors form the degree-zero divisor class group, with every class represented in degree zero; this is only an abstract group.

name: Additivity of the curve Euler characteristic
about: `dim H⁰-dim H¹` is additive in a short exact sequence when the stated finite-dimensionality hypotheses hold and the relevant `H²` vanishes.

name: Commutativity of abelian varieties
about: a proper geometrically integral group scheme over a field is a commutative group object.

name: The general-level valence formula
about: stabilizer-weighted interior and cusp orders of a nonzero form total `k[SL₂(ℤ):Γ]/12` on a finite-index subgroup: valence_formula_finiteIndex.

name: Newform spanning
about: every cusp form on `Γ₁(N)` is a linear combination of degeneracy images of newforms at divisor levels: span_levelRaise_eq_top.

name: The Petersson adjoint formula
about: for `n` coprime to the level, the adjoint of `Tₙ` is `⟨n⟩⁻¹Tₙ`: isAdjointPair_heckeTCuspNat.

name: Atkin–Lehner sign multiplication
about: for a trivial-nebentypus newform, the signs at the maximal prime-power exact divisors multiply to its Fricke sign: prod_atkinLehnerSign_primePow_eq_frickeSign.

name: Hecke’s signed functional equation
about: a trivial-nebentypus newform satisfies `Λ_N(k−s,f)=i^k ε_N(f)Λ_N(s,f)`: frickeCompletedL_sub_eq.

name: The multiquadratic degree formula
about: if no nonempty product of the radicands d₁, …, dₙ is a square in K, then K(√d₁, …, √dₙ) has degree 2ⁿ over K; the Galois group (ℤ/2)ⁿ of sign changes and the subfield lattice rest on it. finrank_adjoin_range

name: The multiquadratic decomposition law
about: at an odd prime p dividing no radicand, every prime above p is unramified, with residue degree 1 if every radicand is a square mod p and 2 otherwise, so p splits completely exactly when every Legendre symbol is 1; the prime 2 obeys the mod-8 analogue when every radicand is 1 mod 4. inertiaDeg_eq_one_iff_forall_legendreSym_eq_one

name: The genus field
about: for imaginary ℚ(√d), the compositum of the quadratic fields of the prime discriminants dividing its discriminant is abelian over ℚ, unramified over ℚ(√d) at every place, and maximal with these properties; for real ℚ(√d) the maximal totally real subfield of that compositum plays this role, and the whole compositum is the narrow genus field in both signatures. isGenusField_candidateGenusField, `isGenusField_candidateGenusFieldReal`

name: The genus-field isomorphism
about: the compositum has Galois group Cl⁺(K)/Cl⁺(K)² over K = ℚ(√d), which is the classical Cl(K)/Cl(K)² for imaginary K, and for real K the totally real genus field has Galois group Cl(K)/Cl(K)². autCandidateGenusFieldEquivNarrowElementaryTwoQuotient, `autCandidateGenusFieldRealEquivElementaryTwoQuotient`

name: The narrow 2-rank formula
about: for a quadratic field of either signature, the narrow class group has 2-rank t − 1, where t is the number of ramified rational primes. narrowTwoRank_eq_ncard_ramifiedPrimes_sub_one

name: The narrow class group
about: fractional ideals modulo principal ideals with a totally positive generator, where the t − 1 count holds for real fields; forgetting positivity costs at most one in 2-rank. NumberField.NarrowClassGroup

name: The conjugate-ideal count
about: in a Dedekind domain, when σ pairs off a finite set S of primes without fixed points, exactly 2^(#S/2) ideals A satisfy A · σA = ∏ S; in a multiquadratic field it supplies the ideals the Erdős unit-distance proof needed for its CM field. TauCeti.ncard_setOf_mul_map_eq_prod

name: The prime-discriminant character group
about: the Dirichlet characters of the subsets of a family of prime discriminants; inside a cyclotomic field they cut out exactly the compositum of the corresponding quadratic fields, the intended route to a cyclotomic description of the genus field. genusCharGroup

name: Dedekind's theorem
about: when `minpoly ℤ θ` is squarefree modulo `p`, the degrees of its irreducible factors modulo `p` are the cycle lengths, fixed points included, of a Frobenius above `p` acting on the roots.

name: Stickelberger's congruence
about: the discriminant of a number field is `0` or `1` modulo `4`.

name: The semi-local decomposition
about: `K_v ⊗[K] L` is the product of the completions `L_w` over the places above `v`, so that `Σ_{w ∣ v} [L_w : K_v] = [L : K]`.

name: The decomposition group is the local Galois group
about: for `L/K` Galois, continuous extension identifies the stabilizer of `w` with `Gal(L_w/K_v)` and, at an unramified place, carries a global Frobenius to the local one.

name: The tame different exponent
about: the exponent of `P` in the different is `e − 1` exactly when the completion at `P` is tamely ramified, and at least `e` exactly when it is wild.

name: The Hille–Yosida characterization
about: a densely defined operator on a real Banach space generates a C₀ semigroup with `‖S(t)‖ ≤ M e^{ωt}` exactly when `M ≥ 1`, `(ω, ∞)` lies in its resolvent set, and `‖R(λ,A)ⁿ‖ ≤ M/(λ−ω)ⁿ` for all `n ≥ 1`.

name: Stone's theorem
about: an operator `A` on a complex Hilbert space is self-adjoint exactly when `iA` generates a unitary C₀-group, which is then unique.

name: The Hausdorff–Bernstein–Widder theorem
about: a function is continuous on `[0, ∞)` and completely monotone on `(0, ∞)` exactly when it is the Laplace transform of a finite positive measure on `ℝ≥0`, and that measure is unique.

name: Bochner's theorem
about: on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space the continuous positive-definite functions are exactly the Fourier transforms of finite Borel measures, and the measure is unique; the characteristic-function form and the classical statement on `ℝ` follow.

name: The Berg–Christensen–Ressel representation
about: a function on `ℝ≥0 × V` is bounded, continuous and positive definite exactly when it is the Laplace–Fourier transform of a finite measure, which is unique.

name: Primal attainment on Polish spaces
about: a lower semicontinuous cost `c : X × Y → ℝ≥0∞` admits an optimal plan between any two probability measures on Polish spaces, and the optimal plans form a compact set.

name: Stability of optimal transport
about: under the liminf and recovery-plan hypotheses the README asks for, optimal values converge and optimal plans converge subsequentially to an optimal plan of the limit (TauCeti.tendsto_transportCost, TauCeti.exists_isOptimalCoupling_tendsto).

name: Stability of optimal transport
about: under the liminf and recovery-plan hypotheses the README asks for, optimal values converge and optimal plans converge subsequentially to an optimal plan of the limit (TauCeti.tendsto_transportCost, TauCeti.exists_isOptimalCoupling_tendsto).

name: Strong Kantorovich duality on compact spaces
about: for a continuous nonnegative cost on compact pseudometric spaces the primal value is the supremum of the continuous dual values, unchanged by admitting integrable potentials; monotone convergence extends this to lower semicontinuous costs on compact metrizable spaces (TauCeti.isLUB_kantorovichDualValue_continuous, TauCeti.isLUB_ofReal_kantorovichDualValue_continuous_of_lowerSemicontinuous).

name: Strong Kantorovich duality on compact spaces
about: for a continuous nonnegative cost on compact pseudometric spaces the primal value is the supremum of the continuous dual values, unchanged by admitting integrable potentials; monotone convergence extends this to lower semicontinuous costs on compact metrizable spaces (TauCeti.isLUB_kantorovichDualValue_continuous, TauCeti.isLUB_ofReal_kantorovichDualValue_continuous_of_lowerSemicontinuous).

name: The gluing lemma
about: two plans sharing a middle marginal have a joint law with both prescribed two-coordinate marginals, in both standard-Borel-sided forms, with countable chains glued through a Kolmogorov extension theorem on countable index types (TauCeti.Measure.exists_glue_of_standardBorel_right, TauCeti.Measure.exists_isProjectiveLimit_of_countable).

about: two plans sharing a middle marginal have a joint law with both prescribed two-coordinate marginals, in both standard-Borel-sided forms, with countable chains glued through a Kolmogorov extension theorem on countable index types (TauCeti.Measure.exists_glue_of_standardBorel_right, TauCeti.Measure.exists_isProjectiveLimit_of_countable).

name: Complementary slackness and optimality certificates
about: a coupling and an integrable dual feasible pair certify each other exactly when the plan is concentrated on the contact set; a certified plan is then optimal, with no duality gap, and concentrated on a measurable `c`-cyclically monotone set (TauCeti.isDualCertificate_iff, TauCeti.IsDualCertificate.exists_isCyclicallyMonotone).

name: Existence and uniqueness for the Dirichlet problem
about: for a divergence-form `L` whose energy form is bounded and coercive on `H¹₀(Ω)`, exactly one `u ∈ H¹₀(Ω)` satisfies `a(u, v) = ∫_Ω f v` for every test `v`. Gårding plus Poincaré discharge coercivity concretely for `-Δ`, and for uniformly elliptic operators with small drift, on domains inside a ball or slab.

name: The Dirichlet eigenfunction basis
about: on a bounded domain with symmetric energy form, `L²(Ω)` has an orthonormal basis of Dirichlet eigenfunctions at positive eigenvalues, and the first eigenvalue is both the minimum of the Rayleigh quotient and the optimal Poincaré constant of the form.

name: The Dirichlet eigenfunction basis
about: on a bounded domain with symmetric energy form, `L²(Ω)` has an orthonormal basis of Dirichlet eigenfunctions at positive eigenvalues, and the first eigenvalue is both the minimum of the Rayleigh quotient and the optimal Poincaré constant of the form.

name: Rellich-Kondrachov
about: for bounded `Ω` and `1 ≤ p < ∞`, the value map `W^{1,p}_0(Ω) → Lᵖ(Ω)` is compact, by a Fréchet-Kolmogorov criterion. This is the compactness that powers everything spectral; the `W^{1,p}(Ω)` statement, which needs boundary regularity, is not available.

name: The weak maximum principle for second-order elliptic operators
about: a `C²` function on a compact set with `c u ≤ Δu + b·∇u`, `c ≥ 0` and `b` bounded inside, is bounded by any nonnegative bound it respects on the frontier, with a counterexample showing `c ≥ 0` cannot be dropped.

name: The Hardy-Littlewood maximal inequality
about: the weak `(1,1)` bound, and by Marcinkiewicz interpolation against `L^∞` the strong `(p, p)` bound for `1 < p < ∞`.

name: Full cycles in prime degree
about: a transitive permutation group of prime degree contains a cycle on all the points, the first of Layer 1's recognition theorems.

name: Double transitivity from a long cycle
about: a transitive subgroup of a finite symmetric group that contains a cycle moving all but one point is doubly transitive.

name: Primitivity from a long cycle
about: the same hypothesis gives primitivity, the form Layer 9's group-theoretic steps consume.

name: The Galois image has the order of the Galois group
about: in any splitting extension the image of the root action has the same order as `Polynomial.Gal`, so permutation invariants of the Galois group can be computed in the image.

name: Cycle types with fixed points are a class function
about: the parts of `Equiv.Perm.partition`, the cycle type with fixed points restored as parts equal to one, are constant on conjugacy classes.

name: Numbering the roots
about: a separable polynomial's roots in its splitting field are in bijection with `Fin p.natDegree`, the temporary numbering every later comparison with a reference subgroup will pass through.

name: The parts of `Equiv.Perm.partition` as the corrected cycle type
about: parts other than one agree with `cycleType` and the ones count fixed points, which is what will let a factorization type of `f mod p` be compared with a permutation in Layers 5 and 6 (Equiv.Perm.count_parts_partition_of_ne_one, Equiv.Perm.count_one_parts_partition).

name: The parts of `Equiv.Perm.partition` as the corrected cycle type
about: parts other than one agree with `cycleType` and the ones count fixed points, which is what will let a factorization type of `f mod p` be compared with a permutation in Layers 5 and 6 (Equiv.Perm.count_parts_partition_of_ne_one, Equiv.Perm.count_one_parts_partition).

name: Unique fixed points
about: a permutation moves all but one point exactly when it has a unique fixed point, bridging the two spellings of the long-cycle theorems.

name: Shapiro's lemma in degrees 0 and 1
about: for profinite `G` and closed `U`, evaluation at `1` is an isomorphism `H¹(G, Coind_U^G A) ≃+ H¹(U, A)`, with inverse a section formula for any continuous coset factorization.

name: The low-degree long exact sequence
about: a short exact sequence of discrete `G`-modules over any topological group gives `δ⁰`, `δ¹` and exactness at all eight nodes from `H⁰(G, A)` to `H²(G, B)`.

name: `cor ∘ res = (G : U)` in degrees 0, 1 and 2
about: corestriction along a finite-index open subgroup, independent of the transversal by an explicit coboundary, satisfies the index identity on cohomology with its correction terms named.

name: The low-degree cup products
about: the six shapes with `p + q ≤ 2`, associativity in all ten tridegrees, graded commutativity on classes, and the projection formula in every shape.

name: The explicit complex is Mathlib's over a discrete group
about: in degrees 0, 1, 2 the explicit cohomology is `groupCohomology` of `Rep.ofDistribMulAction ℤ G M`.

name: The discrete-module dictionary
about: `ofDiscreteModule` lands in the smooth discrete subcategory of `TopRep R G`, equivalent to the discrete `G`-modules, with a non-smooth discrete object exhibited; it is where explicit statements meet the canonical carrier.

name: The finite-quotient system
about: the functor `U ↦ Hⁿ(G ⧸ U, A^U)` on `(OpenNormalSubgroup G)ᵒᵖ`, with all six Layer 4 milestones.

name: The Galois coefficient modules
about: `AbsoluteGaloisGroup K = Gal(Kˢ/K)` identified topologically with Mathlib's, `UnitsCoeff` and `KummerCoeff` as discrete `G_K`-modules, and the Kummer sequence.

name: Limit description of a profinite group
about: a compatible family of elements of the finite quotients of `G` comes from a unique element of `G`, stated outside the category so that later layers can consume it.

name: Correspondence theorem for open normal subgroups
about: the open normal subgroups of `G ⧸ N` correspond, as lattices, to the open normal subgroups of `G` containing `N`.

name: Universal property of the profinite completion
about: continuous homomorphisms from the completion of `G` to a profinite group correspond to abstract homomorphisms from `G`, with the unit bijective when `G` is finite.

name: Quotients by closed normal subgroups are totally disconnected
about: the ingredient the README singles out as missing for `G ⧸ N` to be profinite, proved by the clopen-image argument.

name: Open normal subgroups separate points
about: in a profinite group the intersection of the open normal subgroups is trivial.

name: The pro-`p` predicate
about: `IsProP` says every quotient by an open normal subgroup is a `p`-group; it is the carrier that Layer 2's Sylow predicate, the maximal pro-`p` quotient and the free pro-`p` groups will be stated against, and it already transports along continuous surjections, quotients and topological isomorphisms.

name: Cofinality of open normal subgroups
about: a closed subgroup is the infimum of its joins with the open normal subgroups, which lets arguments over open subgroups above a closed subgroup be run over normal ones.

name: Clopen images in quotients
about: the image of an open subgroup in `G ⧸ N` is clopen, the lemma behind the totally-disconnected instance.

name: The four-fold splitting criterion
about: for units `a, b` of a field in which 2 is invertible, `ℍ[K,a,b]` splits exactly when `b` is a norm from `K(√a)`, when `b = x² − a y²` is solvable, and when `⟨1, −a, −b⟩` is isotropic.

name: Witt's chain-equivalence theorem
about: diagonal forms with unit coefficients and rank at least two are isometric exactly when a chain of permutations and binary replacements joins them (Lam I.5.2, TauCeti.diagonalChain_iff_equivalent).

name: Witt's extension theorem
about: an isometry between regular subspaces of a finite-dimensional quadratic space extends to the whole space (Lam I.4.9, QuadraticMap.IsometryEquiv.exists_extension).

name: `I/I²` is the square-class group
about: the signed discriminant induces `I(K)/I(K)² ≅ Kˣ/(Kˣ)²`.

name: Classification in dimension at most three
about: regular forms of equal dimension at most three are isometric exactly when their discriminants and Hasse invariants agree (Lam V.3.21, QuadraticForm.equivalent_iff_discr_eq_and_hasseInvariant_eq).

name: Isometry classes with a descent principle
about: the carrier is an additively cancellative commutative semiring under orthogonal sum and tensor product, and a function of diagonal presentations that survives permutations, binary steps and, in rank one, rescaling by a square descends to it, as the Hasse invariant does (TauCeti.RegularFormClass, TauCeti.RegularFormClass.liftDiagonal).

name: Isometry classes with a descent principle

name: The Witt ring with Pfister generators
about: `Iⁿ` is additively generated by `n`-fold Pfister classes for `n ≥ 1`, which lets Layer 5 define a homomorphism on `I²` by its values on generators (TauCeti.WittRing, TauCeti.fundamentalIdeal_pow_eq_addClosure).

name: The quaternion symbol in the Brauer group
about: `[(a, b)]` is symmetric, bilinear, 2-torsion and an invariant of the binary form `⟨a, b⟩`, which is what makes the Hasse invariant well defined (TauCeti.BrauerGroup.quaternionClass, TauCeti.RegularFormClass.hasseInvariant).

name: The Hopf algebra–affine group scheme anti-equivalence
about: commHopfAlgCatOpEquivAffineGroupSchemeCat identifies commutative Hopf algebras contravariantly with affine group schemes.

name: The embedding theorem
about: exists_isClosedImmersion_generalLinear embeds every finite-type affine group scheme over a field as a closed subgroup of some general linear group.

name: Tannakian reconstruction
about: fgPointTensorIsoEquiv recovers a commutative Hopf algebra's points as tensor automorphisms of scalar extension on its finite-dimensional comodules.

name: Reductivity of the classical groups
about: GLₙ, SLₙ, and Sp₂ₘ are reductive over every field; SOₙ is reductive in every dimension away from characteristic two.

about: exists_isMaximalTorus gives a maximal torus in every finite-type affine group over a field, while exists_geometricBorel gives a Borel on its geometric fibre.

name: The [Weyl character formula](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/HighestWeight/WeylCharacter.html#TauCeti.formalCharacter_mul_weylDenominator_eq_weylNumerator)

name: The prime-torsion bound for numerical types
about: Stacks Proposition 55.7.4 for every prime ℓ > 768g − 768: a numerical type of genus g ≥ 2 has dim Pic(T)[ℓ] ≤ g, and at most the first Betti number of its intersection graph if minimal.

name: The multiplicity bound for minimal numerical types
about: Stacks Lemma 55.7.3: a minimal numerical type of genus g ≥ 2 has mᵢ|aᵢⱼ| ≤ 768g − 768 for all i, j.

name: The classification of (−2)-configurations
about: Stacks Proposition 55.5.17: a connected proper set of components with aᵢᵢ = −2wᵢ is a chain, a fork, or of type E₆, E₇ or E₈.

about: any two finite separable extensions of a DVR's fraction field, each with a chosen place over the closed point, map compatibly into a third.

name: The Gaussian-Gram form of the Wishart law
about: with positive-definite covariance and at least as many vectors as the dimension, the Gram sum of independent centred Gaussian vectors has the nonsingular Wishart density law, so the two Wishart constructions agree where both are defined.

name: The Bartlett decomposition
about: the Cholesky factor of a standard Wishart matrix of degree `n` has independent entries: standard Gaussian below the diagonal, and chi with `n - i` degrees of freedom in diagonal position `i`, counting from zero.

name: The Wishart mean and covariance
about: for real degree `n > p - 1` and positive-definite scale `S`, the mean is `n • S` and entries `(i, j)` and `(k, l)` have covariance `n (S i k * S j l + S i l * S j k)`, both read off the trace moment-generating function (TauCeti.Probability.integral_id_nonsingularWishartMeasure, TauCeti.Probability.covariance_coe_apply_nonsingularWishartMeasure).

name: Wishart marginals
about: congruence by a `q × p` matrix `M` of full row rank carries the Wishart law of scale `S` to the one of scale `M * S * Mᵀ`, so every principal submatrix of a Wishart matrix is Wishart, with the matching submatrix of `S` as its scale (TauCeti.Probability.map_symmetricCongruenceLinearMap_nonsingularWishartMeasure, TauCeti.Probability.map_symmetricCongruenceLinearMap_submatrix_one_nonsingularWishartMeasure).

name: Wishart marginals

name: The conditional Gaussian law
about: conditioning one block of a jointly Gaussian vector on the other, when the covariance of the observed block is positive definite, gives the Gaussian with affine mean and Schur-complement covariance, packaged as the Markov kernel EuclideanSpace.gaussianCondKernel.

name: Two Wishart families
about: TauCeti.Probability.wishartGramMeasure is the Gram law of `ν` Gaussian vectors at every scale, so singular laws are kept rather than sent to zero, and TauCeti.Probability.nonsingularWishartMeasure is the real-degree density family; both have the same trace moment-generating function, and one argument on it gives the moments of each.

name: Integration over the positive-definite cone

name: Incomplete special functions
about: the error function TauCeti.Real.erf and the regularized incomplete gamma and beta functions express the cdfs that have no elementary form, from the Gaussian and gamma cdfs to the Student t and F cdfs and the binomial, negative-binomial and Poisson tails.

name: Graded Cartan formula
about: for a finite simple graph with no isolated vertex, the graded Cartan matrix of the zigzag relation quotient is `(1 + q²) I + q A_G`, proved entrywise and equal to the graded dimensions `∑_d dim Hom(P_i{d}, P_j) q^d` of the vertex projectives.

name: Orientation independence of the preprojective algebra
about: reversing any set of arrows of a finite quiver gives an isomorphic additive preprojective algebra, the isomorphism negating exactly the reverses of the turned-around arrows, over any commutative ring.

name: Symmetric perfect Frobenius pairing
about: `(x, y) ↦ tr(xy)` on a zigzag algebra without isolated vertices is symmetric and perfect, its Gram matrix being the permutation matrix of an involution of the basis.

name: Centre of a zigzag algebra
about: for a preconnected graph with at least two vertices the centre has basis `1` and the volume classes, hence dimension `|V| + 1`.

name: Affine simply-laced form is positive semidefinite
about: with radical exactly the line of the marks, for every valid affine diagram including `Ã₁`.

name: Effective Hermite–Minkowski count
about: inside a fixed extension `A/ℚ`, the number of number fields with `|d_K| ≤ N` is at most `(2C+1)^(D+1)·D`, with `D` Mathlib's degree bound and `C` an explicit coefficient height; Mathlib gives only finiteness.

name: Hermite–Minkowski generating step
about: every such field is generated over `ℚ` by a root in `A` of an integer polynomial of bounded degree and coefficient height, extracted from Mathlib's finiteness proof.

name: Explicit ideal count
about: for `X ≥ 1` the nonzero integral ideals of norm at most `X` number at most `X²·2ⁿ`, the uniform bound the asymptotic count cannot supply.

name: Lattice doubling bound
about: for an additive subgroup `Λ` of `ι → ℂ`, `#(Λ ∩ box r 2) ≤ 49^#ι · #(Λ ∩ box r 1)`, measure-free.

name: Rank-zero regulator
about: a number field of unit rank zero has regulator `1`, the base case of Layer 3.

name: Polydisc boxes
about: the per-coordinate polydisc `box r c` in `ι → ℂ` on which the packing and doubling bounds are stated, so lattice-point counts can be made without a measure.

name: Hermite-count constants
about: the explicit coefficient height and the monotone count expression, which let a consumer substitute coarser degree or height bounds, a larger threshold, or a natural-number discriminant.

name: Squares in a finitely generated commutative group
about: the subgroup of squares has index at most `2^#S` for a generating set `S`, the engine behind the unit-square index.

name: The `D₈⁺ ≅ E₈` isometry
about: the spinor glue enlargement of the checkerboard lattice `D₈` is isometric, as an integral lattice, to the `E₈` root lattice, via a rational map sending Bourbaki's simple roots to eight glue roots whose Gram matrix is the `E₈` Cartan matrix; `D₈⁺` is even and unimodular with trivial discriminant form.

name: Nikulin's even-overlattice correspondence
about: for an even nondegenerate lattice, even overlattices `L ≤ M ≤ L^∨` are order-isomorphic to quadratic-isotropic subgroups of `A_L`, with the integral/bilinear-isotropic version stated separately and `[L_H:L]=|H|`, `disc(L_H)·|H|²=disc(L)` alongside.

name: The discriminant form of an even overlattice
about: `A_M ≅ H⊥/H` as finite quadratic modules for `H = M/L`, with representative formulas, the order identity, naturality in lattice isometries, and the corollary that `L_H` is unimodular exactly when `H` is Lagrangian.

name: The order of the discriminant group
about: `#A_L = |det Gram L|` for every nondegenerate lattice, with the load-bearing converse that `L^∨` is a full lattice, and `A_L` finite, exactly when `L` is nondegenerate.

name: The ADE discriminant forms
about: `Aₙ`, `Dₙ` of even and odd rank, `E₆`, `E₇` and `E₈` each have their discriminant quadratic module identified up to isometry with an explicit cyclic or Klein-four model carrying the table's half-norm values, not merely the group order; even `Dₙ` is the case order alone cannot settle.

name: The Chebyshev basis
about: chebyshevTHilbertBasis is a Hilbert basis of `L²(measureT)` whose vectors are the normalized `Tₙ`, exercising the general construction on a compact weighted measure rather than the Gaussian.

name: Moment determinacy
about: Measure.ext_of_forall_integral_pow_eq_of_exists_integrable_exp: one finite exponential moment `∫ e^{a|x|}` forces a finite measure on `ℝ` to be determined by its polynomial moments, with the function-level form ae_eq_zero_of_forall_moment_eq_zero. This is the single completeness mechanism behind both summits; it goes via characteristic functions and strip-analyticity of the complex moment generating function, not via an entire Fourier integral as the roadmap sketched.

about: fourier_twoPiHermiteFunction gives eigenvalue `(-i)ⁿ` for the `√(2π)`-rescaled functions `Φₙ`, which is the form Mathlib's `e^{-2πixξ}` convention forces. It is a statement about the Fourier integral of each `Φₙ`, not yet about the Fourier transform as an operator on `L²`.
